title: CPF Module Schema: Machine Learning Compute Instance module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-machinelearningcomputeinstance'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

assign_to_user.description: (Optional) A user that the compute instance is assigned to. object({ object_id = (Optional) The object ID of the user. tenant_id = (Optional) The tenant ID of the user. })

authorization_type.description: (Optional) The Compute Instance Authorization type. Possible values include: personal. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Instance to be created.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

description.description: (Optional) The description of the Machine Learning Compute Instance. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Instance to be created.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below type = "(Required) The type of managed service identity that must be configured. The possible values are `SystemAssigned`, `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Optional) A list of user-assigned managed identity IDs to be assigned to this resource. This is required when `type` is set to `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`."

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

local_auth_enabled.description: (Optional) Enables local authentication methods for the compute instance. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Instance to be created.

machine_learning_workspace_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Machine Learning Workspace. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Instance to be created.

node_public_ip_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether the compute instance will have a public ip.

ssh.description: (Optional) SSH configuration for the compute instance. object({ public_key = (Required) SSH public key for the compute instance. })

subnet_resource_id.description: (Optional) Virtual network subnet resource ID the compute nodes belong to. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Instance to be created.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

virtual_machine_size.description: (Required) The Virtual Machine Size. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Instance to be created.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Machine Learning Compute Instance.

name.description: The Name of the Machine Learning Compute Instance.

resource.description: The Machine Learning Compute Instance resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Machinelearningcomputeinstance' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
